title: The Talk About Texture In Bathroom Design
bodyHtml:
The bathroom, traditionally a hard, white space, now has a softer side. And it’s materiality that has brought another, more tactile, dimension into the picture.

Ceramic, porcelain and cast iron have been the mainstay materials of the bathroom for many decades – some have been around for thousands of years.

In this specialised room of the home, as we discussed in last issue’s newsletter, certain required qualities such as cleanliness have previously restricted the boundaries of design. 

Fast forward to today, and much more is possible. An array of textures are now available for the bathroom, much to the delight of design aficionados everywhere.

These allow much greater freedom of expression, and have the power to create an entirely different, more welcoming atmosphere.

Take for example the Dune series of accessories. A combination of timber and chrome balances old and new, rustic and polished, classic and contemporary. The resulting effect, displayed on a robe hook, toilet brush holder, toilet roll holder and wall-mounted towel rail, has undeniable appeal.

The Leaf robe hook offers a similarly soft experience, available in three pastel colours and a matte finish. Unlike polished and chromed finishes, the matte effect is velvety and subtle, receding from the eye, yet extending to the touch. With each colour available in two sizes, this hook will be as texturally luxurious as the towels and robes you hang off them.

Dot Robe Hooks are available in an array of beautiful textures

Even more texture is available in the Dot range . Black marble and white marble are a classy offering, sure to take your bathroom design from basic to James Bond.

If something a little more understated is more to your taste, you can choose from the timber or stainless steel versions, which have an allure as subtle as perfume. One of the most touched areas in the bathroom is the toilet flush. Now Oli offers three beautiful soft push shades to their range of SLIM pushplate actuators, to bring a little more pleasure into this daily activity.  

Fast forward to today, and much more is possible. Black, white, and grey soft touch options embodies supreme class and restraint, taking the toilet experience to the next level. Many of Studio Bagno’s ceramic ranges are also available in a matte finish, adding a greater tactility than a standard gloss finish. Play around with the options and bring greater depth, and more sensual experience, to the bathroom.
